title: sutra_review: integrate DD + FCA findings
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Wire DD constraint violations and FCA convention violations into sutra_review output. Add `constraint_violations` (cycles, forbidden deps) and `convention_violations` (FCA pattern violations) as separate sections in ReviewResult. Refine risk score to include `convention_violations` signal. Update `recommended_reads` ranking: convention violation sites rank above plain affected symbols.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ReviewResult includes `constraint_violations` section (from DD)
- [ ] ReviewResult includes `convention_violations` section (from FCA)
- [ ] Constraint and convention violations are visually/structurally distinct (different confidence semantics)
- [ ] Risk score incorporates convention_violations signal in breakdown
- [ ] `recommended_reads` ranks convention violation sites above plain affected symbols
- [ ] Tests: fixture with known violations from both DD and FCA, verify they appear in review output in correct sections

## Blocked by

- sutra/v1/9 — DD: blast-radius rollups
- sutra/v1/10 — DD: forbidden deps
- sutra/v1/12 — FCA: convention checking + suppressions
- sutra/v1/13 — sutra_review: structural core

messages.text: Codebase explored. Design: add ReviewFindings struct with DD violations + FCA violations, passed into compute(). Build engines in handle(), keep compute() testable with pre-built findings. Rebalance risk weights to include convention_violations signal.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (covers #13 + #14 together):

Verdict: needs-attention — no-ship as-is

Findings:

1. [high] build_findings errors silently swallowed (review.rs:83) — unwrap_or_default() discards rule-loading, DD, and FCA errors. Malformed rules.toml produces clean-looking review with empty violations. Dangerous for a review gate.
   → Propagate errors or add explicit findings_error/degraded-status field.

2. [medium] FCA convention confidence dropped (review.rs:48-55) — Convention.confidence not propagated into ConventionViolation or serialized. Consumers can't distinguish deterministic DD constraints from probabilistic FCA conventions or rank/suppress by confidence.
   → Propagate support+confidence into fca::ConventionViolation → review::ConventionViolation.

3. [medium] recommended_reads ranking nondeterministic (review.rs:361-390) — violation sites collected via HashSet, no sort before truncation. Can drop higher-risk sites.
   → Sort violation sites by priority/blast/confidence/path before truncating.

4. [medium] Tests bypass real integration path (tests/review-test.rs:247-306) — hand-built ReviewFindings only test compute() serialization, not build_findings/handle/rules-loading/suppression.
   → Add fixture tests with rules.toml + indexed files that invoke handle().

Also flagged: compute() cognitive complexity 31 (threshold 25)."
